name: Android Contract Double Authoring
description: Authoring the fixtures and schema-derived bodies a supervisor-owned ContractDouble serves for a declared integration: declared scenario coverage, request/response/error bodies generated from the integration's declared schema references, deterministic fixture values, and DOUBLE_BACKED evidence classification. The double is supervisor-owned and loopback-bound, and this skill never opens it, never reaches it, and never contacts the real service (BS §79.7; TA §74.1; BS §76.5).
